Hi Priya,

We're kicking off procurement for our upcoming Redwood renewal and the procurement team flagged that we need to refresh vendor onboarding details before we can issue the PO. Attached is Nebula's standard procurement intake (nebuladata_procure_form_v3.pdf).

Quick questions:

Hi Tara — thanks for the intake.

Short answers up front:
- We typically require an updated SOC 2 summary if the customer's procurement window covers a new contract term that extends beyond 12 months since last attestation. I attached the current SOC 2 summary we provide (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf).
- Please complete our vendor questionnaire (attached) rather than the older form — it maps to our procurement portal fields and speeds verification.
- Approval lanes on our side: finance (Laura) approves PO acceptance; legal (Rishi) reviews DPA/SOW redlines; account (me) shepherds timeline and exec approvals for any commercial deviations.

Next steps I propose:
1) You fill out the Redwood vendor questionnaire (attaching redwood_vendor_questionnaire_v2.docx).
2) Share the intended billing entity and PO terms (net30/net45) by 2027-08-05.
3) We'll create a procurement portal refresh request (link below) that auto-populates the vendor profile for internal approvers.

Portal link: https://redwood.example.com/procurement/portal/refresh/NBD-2027
DocuSign (SOW envelope): https://docusign.example.com/envelope/CA12345

If it's helpful I can loop in Marcus from Sales Ops to confirm billing account mapping — Marcus, can you confirm the billing entity mapping for Nebula?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Renewals | Redwood Inference

On Thu, Aug 1, 2027 at 11:03 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll create a procurement portal refresh request...

Hi all — quick legal/procurement note:
- Legal review SLA for standard SOW/DPA redlines: 2 business days for non-substantive edits; 5 business days if the counterparty proposes business-term changes (e.g., data residency, indemnity caps).
- Approver mapping:
  * Contract acceptance: Head of Legal (Rishi) for anything outside standard playbook; otherwise Account Lead (Priya) can sign acceptance on behalf of Redwood for renewals under $200k.
  * Invoice approval/payment: Finance (Laura) — she handles PO acceptance and invoice routing.

Procurement onboarding steps (high level):
1) Vendor questionnaire received and verified against business profile.
2) SOC 2 summary and DPA confirmed.
3) Procurement team enters vendor into our Ariba/Coupa lane for PO routing.
4) PO issued to vendor; vendor confirms receipt and invoicing details.

Attaching a short acceptance checklist we use internally to speed handoffs. Please review and confirm the items you can provide by 2027-08-05.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
